Scenario fixture: form-control-label-quality

Each target has a stable id of the form fclq_case_NN. Fields with no visible programmatic label at all are out of scope — that is form-control-programmatic-label-present's and form-control-programmatic-label-quality's ground.

01 — PASS: wrapping label naming the field
02 — PASS: label[for] naming the field
03 — PASS: repeated labels separated by visible headings

Widget
Gadget

08 — CANTTELL: label left as "Enter text"
